items.item_text: One or more of the following: NAD Level IV certification RID, ACCI certification, NIC, CI/CT, Educational Interpreter Performance Assessment (EIPA) or equivalent from another state.
Some positions in this classification may require the possession of a valid California driver's license.
Provide sign language and oral interpreting services for deaf and hard of hearing students and Antelope Valley College employees. (E)
Send notetaker requests and orientation flyers to instructors.
Assign interpreters; prepare schedules; review timesheets and maintain tracking logs. (E)
Coordinate interpreter evaluations; recruit candidates to be evaluated. (E)
Coordinate training; conduct workshops and maintain/update the Interpreting Handbook as needed. Conduct monthly interpreter meetings. (E)
Remain current on developments, trends and techniques in the interpreting field. (E)

Following the Registry of Interpreters for the Deaf (RID) Code of Ethics, professionally and confidentially perform specialized work in providing a variety of interpreting services for deaf and hard of hearing students and Antelope Valley College employees. (E)

Interpret or transliterate class lectures and other presentations from English to American Sign Language or Conceptually Accurate Signed English (CASE) or by oral interpreting. Sign to voice or simultaneous communication (sim-com) interpreting when appropriate. (E)
Interpret at other events such as field trips, student-teacher conferences, special meetings and other cocurricular activities. (E)
Provide platform interpreting at college-sponsored special events such as graduation. (E)
Provide training and mentoring to interpreters. Serve as a resource for interpreters for vocabulary and other interpreting-related questions. (E)
Meet periodically as needed with deaf students to discuss the quality of their services; make recommendations to resolve any conflicts they may be having. (E)
Provide walk-in deaf services as needed.
Provide substitute interpreting when needed. (E)
Perform related duties as assigned.
Appropriate support services for deaf and hard of hearing students and employees
Provide sign language and interpreting services to college students and Antelope Valley College employees
RID Code of Professional Conduct
Develop and coordinate complex schedules for interpreters
Expressive and receptive modes of manual communications including, but not limited to, American Sign Language, Conceptually Accurate Signed English, Oral Interpreting and Sign to Voice Interpreting.
Establish and maintain effective working relationships with others
Technical and professional signs and vocabulary used in a college setting.
Foster a team working environment
Correct English usage and grammar
Provide supportive guidance and training to others
Cultural and social aspects of deafness
Work in front of large crowds
Repetitive motion injuries and the appropriate exercises to prevent them.
Plan and organize work to be able to effectively meet timelines
Specialized vocabulary, terminology, and basic information in a variety of subjects taught at the college level.
Work independently and confidentially.
Interpreting skill level required for various college-level courses
Communicate effectively both orally and in writing
Technical and working knowledge of a variety of assistive listening devices, real time captioning, and C-Print
Operate standard office equipment including a TDD and URS equipment
